svg.title: Four learning rate decay schedules
svg.desc: Step decay holds the rate constant and multiplies it by one tenth every thirty epochs. Cosine decay, here preceded by a five-epoch linear warmup, sweeps smoothly to zero. Linear decay falls in a straight line to zero. Inverse square root decay falls quickly at first and then flattens without reaching zero.
svg.text: learning rate, as a fraction of its initial value
